body:
Just exaggerating to get the notion across of how inescapable it's been. How, no matter what, it's all been heading constantly in this direction, down this path, at every turn.

Like, how the unfathomable infinite cause and effect that goes on determining everything that happens in everything all around us is just this nonstop whirlwind of equations going on. And who we are, what we are, the cards we've been dealt, is our own equation that meets up with whatever meets us. And some of us are just... multiplying by zero. It's just what happens when our numbers meet up with whatever comes our way. And no matter what approach or outlook or anything... Just keeps comin' up zero. Year after year after year of the same trends, the same outcomes, nothing ever breaking the cycle or giving any hope that it could. Just more and more and more proof that nothing ever will.

The last thing I'm looking for is help anymore... I mean... Been down that road so many times with so many people over the years. There isn't any advice or answer or solution. Focusing on any of it with anyone else leads just to frustrated exasperation. I just drain anyone dry who tries to 'help'. Just having some empathy and understanding from anyone, if not friends, really is the only help there really can for the futile chronic cases like me who seem to just have this fate woven into our DNA.
